notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.content:
After a two-year hiatus, anxiety.exe is back in development!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471624/672f04a651cdcd0e967caab68e769161166b5d47.png[/img]

A change of job, Covid, and most of all, my damn overthinking, pulled us away from focusing on the game. However, I'm happy to inform you that work on anxiety.exe has resumed.

The break from development wasn't all bad though. It allowed us to look at the project from a new perspective and come up with a lot of fresh ideas and improvements to the existing stuff (especially on the design side - two years of freelancing as a graphic designer opened my eyes to some things).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471624/df28caacc530680280f8a97f5778f346567bab3a.gif[/img]

With new energy we sit down to programming, drawing and creating.

Stay safe,
Xiclu
